scope: All 190 previously indexed projects/tools plus requested Nootion. Project Requests and originals are checked for schema/reference consistency; this is not an audit of every original vendor product or a new-project discovery batch.

methods.sources: Fresh batched GraphQL repository identity, archive/disable flags, current commit, README, root license files and recent releases. Codeberg repository, pinned README and license files checked separately. Armada uses its existing documented GitHub mirror.
methods.descriptions: Preserve existing useful detail; correct only supported drift. Compare changed README/supporting-document blobs against exactly pinned previous evidence; unchanged blobs reuse the previous catalog-field review after a fresh hash check. Catalog-relevant sections of additional current documents screened.
methods.licenses: Check current applicable LICENSE/COPYING/LICENCE and dual-license/notice files rather than infer from a single API license.
methods.links: Lychee is not installed locally. Requests-based review uses verified TLS, bounded retries, per-host concurrency, redirect/title checks and separate public Discord invite checks. Repository-configured Lychee remains enabled in CI. Public 200 pages are not treated as proof of runtime app functionality.
methods.validation: Catalog schema passed: 530 originals, 177 projects, 380 requests, five featured; 14 tools reviewed. Tests left to CI under AGENTS.md; hooks enabled. No third-party code executed, no issue comments/closures, no merge or deployment.
